IC3: Previous diagnosis of type 2 diabetes, fulfilling at least one of the following criteria: 1) current treatment with oral antidiabetic drugs [OR] and/or insulin [OR]; 2) a fasting glucose [OR] value above 126 mg/dl on at least 2 occasions; 3) blood glucose level [OR] at 2 hours after an oral glucose tolerance test is equal to or more than 200 mg/dl; or 4) a glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) level > 6.5 %
IC4: Clinical diagnosis of diabetic nephropathy, with a urinary albumin/creatinine ratio >30 mg/g and an estimated glomerular filtration rate more than 20 ml/min per 1.73 m2.
IC5: Treatment with stable doses of angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors [OR], angiotensin II receptor blockers [OR] or anti-aldosterone agents in the last four weeks.
